data.long_meaning: Bipasa is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words 'bipas' meaning 'auspicious' and 'as' meaning 'goddess'. This name is associated with the goddess Shri, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and auspiciousness. The name Bipasa signifies the presence of blessings and good fortune in a person's life. The name Bipasa carries the meaning “Goddess of Auspiciousness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bipasa usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of auspiciousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
